title: This Frog Freezes Solid Every Winter 🧊 #shorts
description: The wood frog survives winter frozen, with no heartbeat, protected by sugar acting as a natural antifreeze.

scenes.text: Every winter, this frog freezes solid, and its heart stops beating.
The wood frog lives as far north as Alaska, above the Arctic Circle.
When temperatures drop, ice spreads through its body. Its breathing stops. Its heart stops.
To survive, it floods its cells with sugar, a natural antifreeze that keeps them from being destroyed.
In spring it thaws, its heart starts again, and it hops away like nothing happened.
Follow for one odd lifeform every day.
